initial_decision.brief_rationale: The verified arithmetic does not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R138-2 to assess the assignment mechanism, Z's causal role, and whether the standardized difference identifies the requested causal effect.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R138-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity, identifying the causal effect by standardization over Z. Each stratum has population weight 0.5. The risk differences are 0.9−0.9=0 and 0.6−0.8=−0.2, yielding 0.5(0)+0.5(−0.2)=−0.1.
